items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Mugsy, had made the crack some place along the line

ctx.x: What the lawyers were trying to do is not involve the cab company in the accident; they said it was my fault. He hit me - I didn't hit him; so it turned out that it was definitely established that it was an accidental death - an accidental death in my favor -- now, how the story got around - now this is only hear-say -- I can't say that this actually happened, but somebody started a rumor; somebody told me at that time that, uh, Mugsy, had made the crack some place along the line that -- I guess Davison was…
So, a lot of musicians picked that up -- you know how a rumor can become a balloon---
